blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト8
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest 8

blocks.source: 質量
blocks.translation: Volume

blocks.source: 開発会社レベル５の作品らしく、広大なマップが特徴。特にフィールドは冒険していて気持ち良い。過剰にあれこれ盛り込もうとするレベル５側を堀井氏が抑えたらしいが、それで、なおこれとは恐れ入る。
blocks.translation: As you would expect from a Level-5 production, the game is characterized by its vast maps. The fields in particular are a pleasure to explore. Apparently, Mr. Horii reined in Level-5's tendency to cram in too many things, but even so, the result is still quite astounding.

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: ５，６，７と印象の薄かったラスボスだが、今回はシナリオを通して暗躍しているため存在感がある。 ラスボス戦もＤＱらしからぬ派手さ。グラフィックの向上によって表現力もアップしている。
blocks.translation: The previous final bosses in 5, 6, and 7 left little impression, but this time the villain has a strong presence because they are plotting behind the scenes throughout the scenario. The final boss battle is also unusually flashy for DQ. The improved graphics have enhanced the game's expressive power as well.

blocks.source: 前作ＤＱ７と比べると、本筋がまとまっており起承転結がしっかりしている。ただし、主人公達が登場人物を見殺しにしてしまうシーンなど、所々やらされてる感も。
blocks.translation: Compared to the previous game, DQ7, the main plot is more cohesive and has a solid narrative structure. However, there are moments when it feels as though you are simply being made to follow along, such as scenes where the protagonists stand by and let characters die.

blocks.source: 他にも『主人公と姫が幼馴染みで仲良し（恋仲？）』という設定は重要なはずだが、今ひとつ見せ方がまずい印象。無口主人公にプレイヤーの意思を挟めない特定キャラとの色恋は似合わないと思う。それでもやるというならば、関係をもっと序盤から掘り下げたほうが良かったんじゃないかなあと。
blocks.translation: The setting that “the protagonist and the princess are childhood friends who are close to each other (perhaps romantically?)” should also be important, but the way it is presented feels somewhat lacking. I don't think a romance with a specific character suits a silent protagonist when the player cannot insert their own will into it. If they were going to do it anyway, I feel they should have developed the relationship more from the beginning.

blocks.source: 個々のイベントは相変わらずおつかい的なものが多め。もっともＤＱに忙しいストーリーは似合わないけれど。
blocks.translation: Individual events are still mostly errand-like tasks. That said, a fast-paced story would not really suit DQ.

blocks.source: １イベント当たりの時間が長いため、今までのシリーズ作品よりもイベント数や町・ダンジョンの数はかなり少なめ。
blocks.translation: Because each event takes a long time, there are considerably fewer events, towns, and dungeons than in previous games in the series.

blocks.source: 『話す』による仲間との会話は今回も存在するが、ＤＱ７の様にいちいち町人の会話にまでは反応してくれない。イベント進行やマップ移動等のタイミングによって内容が変化する程度。
blocks.translation: Conversations with party members using “Talk” are present again this time, but they do not react to every single conversation with townspeople as they did in DQ7. Their dialogue changes only to a limited extent depending on such things as event progression and moving between maps.

blocks.source: といっても、ＤＱ７の会話は余りにも量が多過ぎて読む方も大変だったので、この位の方が丁度いいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: That said, there was so much dialogue in DQ7 that it was difficult for the reader to get through, so this amount may be just right.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: 成長システムのスキルマスターはシンプルながらも、無駄が少ない。全ての特技を覚えることは難しいので、プレイヤーによって、キャラクターの特徴が変わってくる。
blocks.translation: The skill mastery system for character growth is simple but has little waste. Since it is difficult to learn every Tech, each player's choices give the characters different traits.

blocks.source: ＤＱ６やＤＱ７では、全キャラクターが転職によってたくさんの職業や特技を覚えることができたので、ごちゃごちゃになっていた感があったが、今回はすっきりしている。
blocks.translation: In DQ6 and DQ7, every character could learn many jobs and Techs through changing vocations, which made things feel cluttered. This time, the system is much cleaner.

blocks.source: 今回から新システムとして錬金釜が追加された。道具を２～３個合成することで、新しい道具を生み出すというもの。特に目新しいシステムではないが、良いアイテムが錬金できた時は嬉しい。錬金した道具を元の素材より高く売って金策に利用するという工夫もできる。
blocks.translation: A new system, the alchemy pot, has been added this time. It allows you to combine two or three items to create a new one. It is not a particularly innovative system, but it feels good when you manage to alchemize a useful item. You can also sell alchemized items for more than their original materials and use this as a way to raise money.

blocks.source: ただし、一部錬金のレシピの中には貴重な道具を消費する割に作られる物がしょぼい組み合わせがある。この辺はＤＱシリーズにしては珍しく意地悪。
blocks.translation: However, some alchemy recipes produce underwhelming items despite consuming valuable ones. This is unusually mean-spirited for the DQ series.

blocks.source: また、本来ＤＱの金銭バランスというものは不要な道具を売って、金策することを前提に作られていた。しかし、このシステムでは不要な道具でも、いずれ錬金に使用できるかもしれないという懸念があるため、いらない物であっても売りにくい。そのため、いつもより金が不足する印象を受けた。
blocks.translation: Originally, DQ's monetary balance was designed on the premise that you would sell unwanted items to raise money. However, with this system, even an unwanted item might eventually be needed for alchemy, making it difficult to sell anything. As a result, I felt that money was scarcer than usual.

blocks.source: シリーズの中では難易度はやや高め。ザコ敵は強めな上に出現数も多い。大勢の敵に不意打ちされると一気にやられてしまうことがある。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is somewhat high compared with other games in the series. The regular enemies are fairly strong, and they also appear in large numbers. Being ambushed by a large group of enemies can sometimes wipe you out in an instant.

blocks.source: ただし、ラスボスはシリーズの中でも弱め。逆にラストダンジョンはシリーズの中でも難易度が高めなので、これが攻略できたプレイヤーなら、あっさりラスボスを倒せてしまいそう。
blocks.translation: However, the final boss is one of the weaker ones in the series. Conversely, the final dungeon is one of the more difficult, so players who manage to clear it may find themselves defeating the final boss rather easily.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 今作はマップが広いことが特徴だが、その中でも、特に町が広くて大変。
blocks.translation: This game is characterized by its large maps, and the towns in particular are so expansive that they can be a chore.

blocks.source: 町中の宝を集めるのに、普通に数時間かかることもある。ヤンガスの『盗賊の鼻』を使えば、町中の宝の数が表示されるけれど、町によっては、それが３０個以上にもなるので「うわあ……」となる。
blocks.translation: It can easily take several hours just to collect all the treasure in a town. Yangus's “Thief's Nose” displays the number of treasures in town, but in some towns there are more than 30, which makes you go, “Whoa...”

blocks.source: それこそダンジョンより町の探索の方が大変だったと感じるほど。
blocks.translation: It can honestly feel as though exploring the towns is more difficult than exploring the dungeons.

blocks.source: 戦闘時、複数攻撃時に一斉にダメージ表示されるようになったことは嬉しい。
blocks.translation: During battle, it is nice that damage is now displayed all at once when attacking multiple targets.

blocks.source: ただし、演出の強化に伴い全体的にテンポは遅め。ＤＱ５はＰＳ２版で劇的に戦闘テンポが良くなっていたけど、それと比較すると差は歴然。
blocks.translation: However, the overall pace is rather slow because of the enhanced presentation. The PS2 version of DQ5 dramatically improved the battle tempo, but the difference is obvious when compared with that.

blocks.source: ・全体回復時に回復量を１人づつ表示する。
blocks.translation: ・When healing the entire party, the amount healed is displayed one person at a time.

blocks.source: ・味方がダメージを受けた時に現在ＨＰの減少量をいちいち表示。
blocks.translation: ・When an ally takes damage, the decrease in their current HP is displayed every single time.

blocks.source: ・魔法・特技使用時はロードが入る。エフェクトも長め。
blocks.translation: ・Using magic or a Tech triggers a loading sequence. The effects are also fairly long.

blocks.source: ・ＨＰ・ＭＰ回復などの能力を保有していると、毎ターンゆったりとした数値表示が入る。
blocks.translation: ・If a character has an ability that restores HP or MP, a leisurely numerical display appears every turn.

blocks.source: ・敵の同時出現数が多く、必然的に１戦闘が長めに。
blocks.translation: ・Many enemies can appear at once, inevitably making each battle longer.

blocks.source: 等々、気になる箇所が多数あった。改善の余地はたくさんありそう。
blocks.translation: There were many other points like these that stood out. There seems to be plenty of room for improvement.

blocks.source: ロード時間については、今までのＤＱよりは長いけれど、このクオリティの高さを考慮すればそれ以上は高望みかも。
blocks.translation: The loading times are longer than in previous DQ games, but considering the high quality of the game, expecting anything more may be asking too much.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 広大なフィールドについては前述した通り。
blocks.translation: The vast fields are as described above.

blocks.source: 戦闘では鳥山氏の絵がそのまま動く。おなじみのＤＱモンスター達が動く様子は感動。
blocks.translation: In battle, Mr. Toriyama's illustrations move exactly as they are. Seeing the familiar DQ monsters in motion is truly moving.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 通常戦闘曲はちょっと地味な印象。戦闘テンポにはあっているけれど、眠くなってきそうかも。
blocks.translation: The regular battle theme feels a little plain. It suits the battle tempo, but it might make you start feeling sleepy.

blocks.source: ＤＱのラスボス戦の音楽と言えば、一番人気のＤＱ３を除いて、格好良さよりも恐怖感や威圧感を押し出したものが多かったが、今回は久々に勇ましく格好良い。某曲のアレンジをここで使用するというのも粋。
blocks.translation: When it comes to music for DQ final boss battles, except for the most popular one from DQ3, many themes have emphasized fear and intimidation over coolness. This time, however, the music is brave and stylish for the first time in a while. It is also a nice touch to use an arrangement of a certain song here.

blocks.source: また、過去のシリーズ作品から懐かしい曲も登場。今作はＤＱ４の頃のように曲数が多く、町や塔など全体的な質も高い。
blocks.translation: Nostalgic songs from past games in the series also make an appearance. Like DQ4, this game has a large number of songs, and the overall quality of the music for towns, towers, and so on is high.
